svg.title: Corpus coverage over fold depth and coupling
svg.desc: 600 samples binned by fold depth and by creases made per fold. Peak cell holds 54 samples.
svg.text: fold depth (folds in the reference sequence)
Depth and coupling are not independent: an all-layers fold thickens the stack, so a long sequence cannot keep cutting few layers.
No sample reaches 15 folds at coupling below 4; the deepest such sample has 14. Real folders reach that corner by pre-creasing, which this action space excludes.
